title: Phase 6.4A Prompt-Only Baseline Response Contract
description: The strict model-facing response contract for the prompt-only baseline arm. The model returns exactly one JSON object with exactly three keys and nothing else (no markdown, no code fence, no chain-of-thought). Enforced offline by agent_arena.prompt_only_baseline.parse_baseline_response.

predicted_label.description: Exactly one of the four frozen labels.

confidence.description: Degree of belief that the selected top label is correct, in [0,1]. Booleans are INVALID. A missing or invalid confidence is classified MISSING/INVALID and NEVER coerced to 0.0.

brief_reason.description: One or two concise sentences grounded only in the supplied claim and evidence. No chain-of-thought.

x_parser_rules.malformed_or_repaired_json: parser failure (parse_ok=false); never a verdict; never retried
x_parser_rules.confidence_validity: VALID / MISSING / INVALID per Phase 6.1 confidence_semantics; no 0.0 coercion

x_notes: The comparison result envelope reuses the Phase 6.2 anonymized_result_contract (envelope_version 6.2.0): records keyed by opaque DEV-#### only; no canonical/BIAA/HLD ids or salt.
